name: crab-buddy
description: A pixel crab with a life of its own on a little beach above the prompt that also lends a claw: a red flag while Claude waits for you, a ready /compact at the right moment, an hourglass for your usage limit, a sea that shows your context, real sky, seasons and weather, costume beaches, unlockable decor, a fishing line for each subagent, one crab that can roam between your windows, signs for news, needs you care for and break reminders.

longTaskSeconds.title: Long task (seconds)
longTaskSeconds.description: A turn at least this long ends with a wave, a toast and a chirp; 0 turns it off

breakMinutes.title: Break reminder (minutes)
breakMinutes.description: Minutes of continuous work before the crab suggests a break; 0 turns it off

budgetUsd.title: Budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: On API billing: the session budget the hourglass counts down, with signs at 80% and 95%. 0: no hourglass on API billing. A subscription's usage limit needs no setting.

sound.title: Done chirp
sound.description: Play a short chirp when a long task finishes

bubbles.title: Speech bubbles
bubbles.description: How often the crab talks on its own; your care actions always get a reply unless off

weatherPlace.title: Weather place
weatherPlace.description: Whose real weather shows on the beach (rain, snow, wind). "auto" (recommended): your time zone's city (e.g. Europe/Berlin is Berlin), sending nothing new. "auto-ip": your city by IP lookup at ipwho.is, which sees your IP address, every 3 hours. A city name: its name and coordinates go to open-meteo.com once an hour. Empty: no weather is fetched.

signs.title: Signs
signs.description: The crab holds up signs for news: a task done, a coffee break, a walk, commits, pushes, PRs and MRs. Off: bubbles and toasts carry it.
